You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-webhook-driven-2|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and software without platform fees is a reality with sovereign commerce stacks. These stacks are not workarounds, but base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their online stores, payment processing, and data ownership. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can say goodbye to hefty fees like Gumroad's 10% charge and hello to more profit with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with no KYC or buyer account required. This architecture ensures that creators have complete control over their infrastructure and data, eliminating the need for third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can scale their businesses without worrying about platform fees, restrictions, or compliance issues. It's not just about avoiding fees; it's about taking control of your online presence and data ownership.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks eliminate platform fees and give creators full control over their online presence and data ownership.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With this kit, creators can deploy a stack in 48 hours, load 5 products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and end-to-end test their infrastructure. The kit includes documentation, source code, and NOWPayments integration guides to ensure a seamless deployment process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, start by choosing the right components for your needs. Select a hosting platform, backend logic solution, order storage service, and file delivery system. Next, integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Finally, configure your infrastructure to ensure a seamless payment and delivery process. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to shop for the Complete Builder Kit and get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Selling digital products with NOWPayments means accepting payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with no KYC or buyer account required.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Select a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Choose a file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Configure your infrastructure for seamless payment and delivery.

No, you don't need to be a technical expert to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you get documentation, source code, and NOWPayments integration guides to ensure a seamless deployment process.

Yes, with NOWPayments, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT.

No, you don't need to have a buyer account or KYC with NOWPayments. This means you can accept payments from anyone, anywhere in the world, without worrying about compliance issues.
